description: A cotangent follows a live angle while its numeric snapshot stays frozen
code:
angle = 1
ratio = Math.cot(angle)
frozen = ratio.value
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.tan(1))
angle = -1
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.tan(-1))
assert(frozen, 1 / Math.tan(1))
[ratio < 0, frozen > 0]

description: Cotangent keeps intrinsic numeric conversion and missing-input NaN
code:
input = " 1 "
ratio = Math.cot(input)
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.tan(1))
input = ["0.5"]
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.tan(0.5))
input = Date(-1)
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.tan(-1))
assert(Math.cot(null), Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
assert(Math.cot(-0), Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
assert(Number.isNaN(Math.cot()), true)
input = [1, 2]
assert(Number.isNaN(ratio), true)
Number.isNaN(ratio)

description: An ignored cotangent argument still defers a ratio when its property is absent
code:
class Probe
probe = Probe()
probe.angle = 1
ratio = Math.cot(probe.angle, probe.extra)
assert(ratio, null)
probe.extra = Number.NaN
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.tan(1))
delete probe.extra
assert(ratio, null)
probe.extra = [1, 2]
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.tan(1))
probe.angle = -0
assert(ratio, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
probe.angle = 1
ratio == 1 / Math.tan(1)

description: Independent directional cotangents survive a failed transactional angle change
code:
class Direction(angle):
    this.angle = angle
$Direction.ratio = Math.cot($Direction.angle)
first = Direction(1)
second = Direction(-1)
assert([first.ratio, second.ratio], [1 / Math.tan(1), 1 / Math.tan(-1)])
try:
    first.angle = 0
    throw "RESTORE"
catch error:
    assert(error, "RESTORE")
assert(first.angle, 1)
assert(first.ratio, 1 / Math.tan(1))
assert(second.ratio, 1 / Math.tan(-1))
delete first.angle
assert(first.ratio, null)
first.angle = 0.5
assert(first.ratio, 1 / Math.tan(0.5))
Direction.length
